title: MI-VAL Dataset Descriptor
description: The dataset side of the RSNA ATLAS dataset.json, re-expressed against MI-CDM. Unlike a file-list descriptor, this one is a *query*: the dataset is whatever the cohort + retrieval spec resolve to at the executing site, which is exactly what makes it portable across institutions.

atlas_definition_json.description: Full ATLAS export. Required for cross-site portability — an id alone does not reconstruct a population.

retrieval.description: Which image_occurrence rows count as 'the study image' for each subject. Every ambiguity a reviewer would ask about is a named field here.

metadata_filters.description: MI-CDM feature name -> required value or list of allowed values.

local_path_root.description: Site mount point. Overridden per site; never travels with a shared manifest.

labels.description: Outcome definition. Also an ATLAS cohort in most studies — keeping it as a cohort id rather than a hand-built column is what makes the label auditable.

characteristics.description: Concept sets for the step (2) clinical panel.
